description: God is intimately involved in the plans for my life. Not because I have earned it. Because His faithful love endures forever.
excerpt: The reason God is going to work out His plans for my life is not tied to how well I am performing. It is tied to who He is. His faithful love endures forever. His involvement in my life is not conditional on me.
verse: "The Lord will work out his plans for my life—for your faithful love, O Lord, endures forever. Don't abandon me, for you made me."
body_html:
God is intimately involved in the plans for my life.

That is what the psalms keep saying over and over, and I love that. He is not distant. He is not hands off. He is not watching from a chair somewhere waiting to see how it all plays out. He is in it. He has plans. He is working them out. And the reason He does all of this is not because I have earned it. It is because of His faithful love.

That is why I highlighted this. I wanted to remember.

The reason God is going to work out His plans for my life is not tied to how well I am performing. It is tied to who He is. His faithful love endures forever. Which means when I am doing well, He is still working. When I am struggling, He is still working. When I have no idea what is happening, He is still working. His involvement in my life is not conditional on me.

Then David says something that made me re-read the verse.

Don't abandon me, for you made me.

He is not demanding anything. He is not entitled. He is essentially asking God to remember him because God is the one who created him. There is a humility in that. He is not saying do not abandon me because I have been good or do not abandon me because I have earned Your attention. He is saying You made me. I belong to You. Please stay.

I love that posture.

Because it recognizes what we so often forget. We do not deserve God's attention. We do not deserve His plans. We do not deserve His faithful love. But He gives it anyway. And when we go back to Him, we do not have to bring a list of what we have accomplished. We just bring who we are. His creation. Made by Him. Belonging to Him.

That is enough.
question: Where in your life do you need to remember that God is intimately involved in your plans, not because you have earned it, but because His love endures forever?
